pyramiding_rule: Prohibit averaging or pyramiding into positions unless the initial trade is in-the-money by at least 1.5x the initial stop-loss distance.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require volume delta confirmation and a minimum 3-pip clearance beyond structural swing highs/lows before executing order entry.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate dynamic partial profit harvesting at +$10.00 and trail remaining volume with a volatility-adjusted ATR stop to capture +$15.00 to +$30.00 runs.
